title: Learning diffusion at lightspeed
tldr_zh: JKOnet*：用 JKO 步一阶最优性条件替代双层优化，单层二次损失同时学 potential/interaction/internal 能量，线性参数化有闭式解
tldr_en: JKOnet* replaces the bilevel JKO inverse problem by a quadratic loss on the JKO first-order optimality condition, learning potential, interaction and internal energies with a closed form for linear features.
key_numbers: Embryoid-body scRNA-seq one-step EMD (5 PCs, 60/40 split, 5 seeds): JKOnet*_V time-varying 0.624+-0.007 vs JKOnet 1.363+-0.214, JKOnet-vanilla 3.237+-1.135 (Sec. 4.4 table)
Literature numbers under a different protocol: DMSB 0.67, NLSB 0.74, OT-CFM 0.790, MIOFLOW 0.79, Reg. CNF 0.825, TrajectoryNet 0.848, DSB 0.862, I-CFM 0.872, SB-CFM 1.221 (Sec. 4.4 table)
Per-epoch complexity: JKOnet O(T(DNd + N^2 log N / eps^2)) vs JKOnet* O(TNd) without interaction, O(TN^2 d) with interaction; linear version closed form O(TNdn + n^3) in one epoch (Table 1)
Precomputing OT couplings costs 0.03+-0.01 s on synthetic tasks (tau=0.01, T=5, 15 potentials); JKOnet-vanilla diverges (NaN) on several potentials (Fig. 3)
Scaling: N in {1000..10000}, d in {10..50}, EMD grows sublinearly in d (Fig. 4); training on scRNA-seq takes minutes vs hours for baselines (Sec. 4.4)
